punchline: A child without a phone is left out when everyone else has one, which is why Haidt asks whole schools to act together.
thirty_sec: Haidt says childhood was rewired between about 2010 and 2015, from outdoor play to phones, and teenage anxiety rose. One family saying no leaves its child out, so he asks schools and communities to set shared rules: phone-free schools, later ages and more independent play. Some researchers dispute the cause.
